insights.summary: Front-line teams say AI call summaries save time on callbacks, dispatch and handoffs.
insights.quote: The Signal AI summaries. Our front-line folks, the BDC reps, the service advisors, they all say the same thing: they read the summary instead of listening to the whole recording. Saves them a ton of time on callbacks and dispatch.
